title: I am only interested in owning Pinnacle Blooms Network in this location, No other?
metaTitle: Owning Pinnacle Blooms Network in Specific Locations - FAQ
description: Interested in owning a Pinnacle Blooms Network facility in a specific location? Find out more about the possibilities and considerations. Contact us to explore franchise opportunities.
html: While the applicant’s wishes are a very strong consideration, Pinnacle Blooms Network cannot guarantee that a facility in the applicant's preferred area will be offered.
